description.text: Entrance Examinations 1. HSK6 or higher 2.comprehension examinations (written) 3. interview Teaching materials: 150 to 300 CNY/semester

duration.text: The Biomedical Engineering at Sichuan University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3055 USD/per year ￥ 22000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. Health certificate(optional) Photocopy of physical examination record. 6. Two recommendation letters From professor,associate professor or equivalents.

requirements.text: 1.Under 35 years old 2.Senior middle school education with decent grades
